## Market Trends & Size
Teams increasingly want faster validation loops before committing engineering time. The surrounding market includes research tooling, lightweight audit services, and AI-assisted product analysis, which suggests sustained demand for faster early-stage decision support.

## Positioning Analysis
Mega Eval is strongest when a team wants a repeatable workflow rather than a one-off opinion. The clearest positioning angle is structured, multi-perspective analysis that combines critique, market context, and next-step synthesis in one run.

## Risks & Considerations
- Reliance on host capabilities can make portability harder
- Thin public market data may reduce confidence in niche categories
